name: The Palaces of King Ludwig II of Bavaria: Neuschwanstein, Linderhof, Schachen and Herrenchiemsee
description: Four fairy-tale palaces in the Bavarian Alps were built by "Fairy Tale King" Ludwig II between 1868 and 1886 as private retreats. Neuschwanstein perches on a rocky crag, Linderhof and Schachen nestle in mountain landscapes, and Herrenchiemsee, on a lake island, is a vast homage to Versailles. Drawing on medieval legend and Wagner's operas, they opened to visitors soon after his death.
